head: 0034d93b4b98
head_note: head is the commit before this file was added; see git log for the final sha

c61_nb.note: arm 1: GaussianNB class stats single blocked pass (Welford per block, Chan merge, compensated M2); arm 2: also epsilon's column variance from the class M2, so unweighted fit walks X once (incumbent: 4 walks). Class means/counts/sums keep incumbent words; variances change.

c61_da.note: LDA svd fit: within-class std from pooled class M2 (csbm_pool) instead of materialising X - mean[y] (n*d) and two column-stat passes; LDA lsqr/eigen and QDA with shrinkage: single-pass class variance. Board qda (reg_param, no shrinkage) reads no class variance: not reached.

c04_lda.note: LDA transform only; not on the board lda-clf route (fit + predict/proba). PCA half stays C04_LOAD_CENTER (lane L2 renames it C04_PCA).

c56_lda_input.note: binary decision_function only (skips the discarded K-score program); not on the board lda-clf route.

c56_qda_project.note: was MOJOLEARN_C56_QDA_PROJECT4 (fixed 4); now width arms. qda_dec = QDA predict/predict_proba (board inference column).

expanded:gaussian-nb.route: fit: _gnb_stats -> (_col_stats + gnb_eps) + _class_stats[csb1_part, csb_fold, csb1_ss, csb_var] | C61_NB: csbm_part, csbm_fold (+ csbm_pool, gnb_eps on arm 2) -> gnb_params; predict: gnb_jll

expanded:multinomial-nb.route: fit: _nb_counts (csb1_part + csb_fold, already one pass, sums only) -> mnb_params

expanded:bernoulli-nb.route: fit: _nb_counts with binarize threshold (csb1_part + csb_fold) -> bnb_params

expanded:categorical-nb.route: fit: cat_hpart / cat_hfold histogram counts -> cat_params

expanded:lda-clf.route: fit(svd): _cls[csb1_part, csb_fold] -> lda_prep -> center_rows(z) -> _cs(z) -> lda_w | C61_DA: csbm_part, csbm_fold, csbm_pool -> lda_w; then center_rows(z2) -> _gram -> eigh -> lda_stage2 -> eigh -> lda_stage3; predict/proba: matmul jll
expanded:lda-clf.note: NV istella 1.83x (T.combined.minus-C55) is preparation_seconds 5.22 vs 2.15 s; fit 1.412 vs 1.428 s, inference equal: no define cause (~/mojolearn-evidence/classical-nbda-lda-istella-1.83x.txt)

expanded:qda.route: fit: _cls[csb1_part, csb_fold] (means only) -> lda_prep -> _qda_cov -> eigh -> qda_prep; predict/proba: qda_dec

removed.reason: measured loser: serial (class-group, column) walk of all n rows twice, plain f32 sums; gaussian-nb taxi 3.76x NV / 7.30x AMD and quality failed (gaussian-nb taxi, lda-clf istella). Code deleted; row in docs/apple-fast/EXPERIMENTS.md
renamed into the arms switch MOJOLEARN_CLASSICAL_C56_QDA_PROJECT=4
LDA use split to MOJOLEARN_CLASSICAL_C04_LDA; C04_LOAD_CENTER now only reaches PCA
